fichas.title: Multiplex Cinemas: Planning Forms
fichas.summary: The town-planning situation influences how many cinema screens can be combined in one unit. The page describes layered stacking, horizontal rows, and combinations with other functions such as shopping centres and car parks. One common combination places sales areas on the ground floor and cinema screens and parking on the first floor; the text describes a prominent urban landmark with two high-rise point buildings.
uses: Combining multiple cinema screens in a unit
Combining cinema facilities with shopping and parking functions

fichas.title: Kosmos Cinema, Berlin
fichas.summary: The page shows a plan and an elevation/section of the Kosmos cinema in Berlin. The plan legend identifies cinemas, foyer, offices, and parking areas. Architect: Rohde Kellermann Wawrowsky.

fichas.title: Filmpalast Dresden
fichas.summary: The page presents a plan and a view/section of Filmpalast Dresden, showing cinema auditoria within a distinctive architectural form. Architect: Coop Himmelb(l)au.

fichas.title: Neustadt Centrum Halle
fichas.summary: The page shows the cinema level first-floor plan, the shopping-level ground-floor plan, and a section of Neustadt Centrum Halle. The text describes this type of combination as incorporating cinema screens and parking with shopping functions. Architects: Hermann & Valentiny with Noack und Partner.
fichas.building_type: Mixed-use shopping centre and multiplex cinema
